scope: all 445 native recordings, both feet, all 48 channels
numerical_policy: preserve all raw measurements; no new numeric corrections
persistent_floor: min>=20 AND min>=0.8*p95; observation, NOT zero-bias/fault proof
hampel: 5 source rows; deviation>max(20,3*1.4826*MAD); boundary/gap suppression; advisory only
clipping: value>1023 is current model clipping risk, not hardware limit
time: native receive clock only; conflicting exact timestamps unusable; no offset fitting/interpolation
temporal: exclude missing/invalid clock, conflict, backward step and gap-adjacent rows; strictly increasing segments
human_review: 80 labels including explicit correction; 42/42 priority done; no further manual annotation required
